Virtual Walk-In Interview - IT Engineers 
 Saturday, October 31 • 10:00am 4:30pm 
 Google Meet joining info 
 Video call link: https://meet.google.com/fae-phgb-nyy 

 Key Responsibilities Act as the first escalation point for incidents triaged by L1 engineers that require deeper investigation. Perform root cause analysis (RCA) by correlating APM traces, infrastructure metrics, network telemetry, logs, Synthetics results, and RUM data. Configure and fine-tune advanced Datadog capabilities: custom metrics, log pipelines, monitors with composite/anomaly detection, SLOs, and dashboards aligned to service ownership. Guide and review Datadog APM instrumentation coverage across services; identify monitoring gaps and recommend improvements. Independently identify whether an issue originates in the application tier, infrastructure, network, or a third-party dependency, in both 3-tier and cloud-native (microservices/containerized) environments. Lead or actively participate in major incident bridge calls, providing observability data to speed up resolution. Own problem management: identify recurring incidents, drive permanent fixes, and track them to closure. Mentor and coach L1 engineers on triage techniques, Datadog usage, and escalation quality. 
 Contribute to automation of routine monitoring tasks (alert enrichment, auto-remediation triggers, ticket auto-creation). Support capacity and performance trend analysis using historical Datadog data. Review and refine monitors to reduce noise and false positives (alert tuning). Ensure adherence to SLAs/OLAs and maintain quality of incident documentation and RCA reports. Participate in client/stakeholder calls to explain incidents, trends, and improvement plans. Required Skills and Experience Observability Platform Skills 3 to 6 years of experience in Managed Services, NOC, SRE, or application/infrastructure support roles, with at least 1-2 years working hands-on with Datadog. Strong working knowledge of Datadog across monitoring, dashboards, alerting, APM, Synthetics, RUM, logs, metrics, SLOs, and service-level troubleshooting. Advanced monitor configuration (anomaly detection, forecast, composite monitors, SLOs). APM: distributed tracing, service maps, trace analytics, and identifying instrumentation gaps. Synthetics: designing multi-step API and browser tests, analyzing failure trends. RUM: correlating front-end performance and errors with backend traces. Log Management: building log pipelines, parsing rules, and log-based metrics. Solid understanding of infrastructure concepts: compute, storage, containers, orchestration (Kubernetes basics), and cloud resource scaling. Solid understanding of networking fundamentals: DNS, load balancing, latency/packet loss analysis, firewall and connectivity troubleshooting. Strong analytical ability to read application logs, stack traces, and error patterns to isolate the failing component, without needing to be an expert in the underlying code. Experience with ITSM tools for incident, problem, and change management. Working knowledge of ITIL processes, especially incident and problem management. Application and Architecture Understanding Solid understanding of 3-tier application architecture and how load, latency, or failure at one tier cascades to others. Solid understanding of cloud-native architecture: microservices, containers, API gateways, service meshes, and inter-service communication patterns. Ability to correlate application-level symptoms (errors, latency, timeouts) with underlying infrastructure or network causes using observability data alone. Understanding of common resiliency patterns (retries, circuit breakers, caching, load balancing) and how their failure shows up in monitoring data. Good to Have Datadog certification (APM, Infrastructure, or Log Management specialization). Scripting experience (Python, Shell, PowerShell) for automation and custom integrations. Exposure to Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) for managing Datadog configuration as code. Experience with CI/CD pipelines and how deployments correlate with monitoring 
 anomalies. Exposure to other observability or APM tools (New Relic, Dynatrace, Splunk, Grafana, Prometheus). Soft Skills Strong ownership and accountability for incident resolution. Ability to communicate technical findings clearly to both technical teams and stakeholders. Mentoring ability and patience when guiding L1 engineers. Comfortable leading discussions during high-pressure major incidents. Structured approach to documentation and knowledge sharing. Education Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

Key Skills: Log Management,ITIL,AWS,Production support,Support services,Kubernetes,Monitoring,Infrastructure

title: Senior Procurement Executive
description:
Senior Executive Procurement 
 Location: Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu Employment Type: Full-time Experience: 3 to 6 years Languages Required: English, Native language & Hindi (fluent) Education: Bachelor's in Business/Agribusiness/Food Technology/Commerce/SCM or related field 
 Why This Role Exists 
We depend on getting the right raw materials, at the right price, without compromising on quality. Good procurement isn't just about negotiating the lowest price - it's about protecting quality standards while doing it, so the group gets consistent, reliable supply it can build every product on. This role owns that balance - sourcing competitively while never trading away quality. 
 What You'll Be Doing Identify, evaluate and develop reliable suppliers across group companies requirements, with backup suppliers to secure continuity. Obtain and evaluate supplier quotations and lead negotiations on price, payment terms, MOQ and delivery - balancing cost savings with strict quality standards. Track market prices, seasonal trends, crop cycles and supply risk and flag significant shifts to Management. Coordinate with Quality Control to ensure materials meet required specifications, and drive resolution on rejected or non-conforming materials. Own purchase orders end-to-end from supplier confirmation through final delivery - including coordination with Logistics. Drive cost optimization and process improvement, without compromising quality or supply reliability. Coordinate with Sales/BD, Quality, Logistics, Accounts and Management across group companies to align procurement with business needs. Maintain accurate procurement records and prepare reports on pricing, deliveries, quality issues and cost savings. 
 What We're Looking For Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Agribusiness, Food Technology, Commerce, Supply Chain Management or a related field. 3 to 6 years of experience in Procurement, Purchase, Sourcing, Supply Chain or Vendor Management. Experience in FMCG, food products, agricultural commodities, spices or dehydrated vegetables highly preferred. Strong negotiation and vendor management skills with an eye for quality, not just price. Good working knowledge of MS Excel/Google Sheets, ERP or procurement software exposure is a plus. Fluent in English, Tamil and Hindi, with strong stakeholder-management ability. Willing to travel to supplier markets and sourcing locations and across group company sites if needed.

Key Skills: Senior,Procurement management,Procurement planning,Procurement,Management,Planning,Purchase,Strategic sourcing

 LTM is seeking a Specialist - Cloud Engineering to lead digital workplace and end-user services strategy, driving scalable hybrid cloud solutions, endpoint collaboration, and virtual workspaces to elevate enterprise productivity and operational excellence.

title: Senior Demand Planning Analyst / Consultant
description:
Role Summary Plan Optimus is looking for an experienced Demand Planning Analyst / Consultant with 4+ years of hands-on experience working with leading supply chain planning platforms such as Blue Yonder, o9 Solutions, or Kinaxis . The ideal candidate should have strong functional knowledge of demand forecasting, statistical forecasting, demand planning processes, and Integrated Business Planning (IBP). The candidate will work closely with our product development, implementation, and customer-facing teams to design, enhance, configure, and support the Plan Optimus Demand Planning solution. This role requires an individual who can independently understand business planning requirements, translate them into functional specifications, work with technical teams, and contribute to building a competitive enterprise demand planning platform. Key Responsibilities 1. Demand Planning Solution Design & Development Work with the Plan Optimus product development team to design and enhance demand planning capabilities. Translate business requirements into functional specifications, workflows, configuration requirements, and solution designs. Apply experience from Blue Yonder, o9, or Kinaxis to recommend industry-standard demand planning features and best practices. Define planning workflows, business rules, calculations, exceptions, and KPIs. Participate in solution testing, validation, and product enhancements. 2. Demand Forecasting & Analytics Support statistical forecasting, baseline forecasting, and demand forecasting processes. Understand forecasting methods, including moving averages, exponential smoothing, trend, seasonality, and machine learning-based forecasting. Analyze forecast accuracy, forecast bias, MAPE, WMAPE, and other demand planning KPIs. Support demand sensing, promotional planning, new product introductions, and product cannibalization analysis. Assist in developing exception-based planning and demand planning dashboards. 3. Demand Planning Configuration & Implementation Configure demand planning parameters, planning hierarchies, time buckets, and business rules. Support demand planning implementations, enhancements, and ongoing application support. Understand demand planning data requirements, including sales history, product hierarchies, customer hierarchies, promotional events, and external demand drivers. Collaborate with technical teams on data integration, validation, and planning calculations. Troubleshoot functional issues and recommend improvements. 4. Business Analysis & Customer Engagement Conduct requirement-gathering sessions with customers and business stakeholders. Understand existing demand planning processes and identify opportunities for improvement. Prepare functional requirement documents, solution design documents, test scenarios, and user acceptance testing plans. Conduct solution demonstrations, user training, and workshops. Work independently as a Demand Planning Subject Matter Expert (SME). 5. Product Development & Cross-Functional Collaboration Collaborate with software developers, data engineers, data scientists, and optimization specialists. Provide functional inputs for AI-enabled demand planning, scenario planning, and exception management. Work with Supply Planning, Inventory Planning, and S&OP teams to ensure integrated planning capabilities. Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies, sprint planning, and product backlog prioritization. Mentor junior analysts and support knowledge sharing. Must-Have Skills 4+ years of experience in Demand Planning , including hands-on experience with at least one of the following:
 Blue Yonder Demand Planning o9 Solutions Demand Planning / Integrated Business Planning Kinaxis RapidResponse / Maestro Demand Planning Strong understanding of demand forecasting, statistical forecasting, and demand planning business processes. Experience configuring, implementing, enhancing, or supporting enterprise demand planning applications. Ability to translate business requirements into functional specifications and technical requirements. Experience with demand planning hierarchies, forecasting parameters, planning workflows, and exception management. Good understanding of forecast accuracy metrics, including MAPE, WMAPE, and forecast bias. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and working knowledge of SQL. Experience working with software development teams in Agile/Scrum environments. Strong communication, documentation, and stakeholder-management skills. Ability to work independently and take ownership of functional deliverables. Good-to-Have Skills Experience with Integrated Business Planning (IBP), Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP), Supply Planning, or Inventory Optimization. Experience in CPG, Food & Beverage, Retail, Quick Service Restaurants (QSR), or Distribution industries. Exposure to AI/ML-based demand forecasting and predictive analytics. Knowledge of Python, SQL, Snowflake, or modern data analytics platforms. Experience with promotional forecasting, demand sensing, new product forecasting, and cannibalization. Collaborate with process/controls engineers to identify new tagging, KPI, and analytics requirements. provide Tier 2/3 support and root-cause analysis for PI System issues.Required Technical Skillset Strong hands-on experience with AVEVA System Platform (Application Server / Galaxy, Historian, InTouch, Web Client / Operations Control). Proficiency in OPC UA/DA, Modbus, and native communication drivers for PLC/DCS integration Experience with scripting (QuickScript/VBScript) and object-oriented Galaxy template design. Understanding of network/OT architecture, redundancy, cybersecurity hardening (ISA/IEC 62443 awareness a plus), and virtualization (VMware) for industrial systems. Familiarity with SQL Server/reporting tools for Historian data extraction and dashboarding (AVEVA Insight / Reports is a plus). Pharmaceutical / Regulatory Domain Expertise (Preferred) Sound knowledge of GAMP 5 computerized system validation (CSV/CSA) lifecycle and documentation practices. Soft Skills & Other Requirements Strong client-facing communication skills; ability to work directly with pharma quality, validation, and automation stakeholders. Ability to prepare and present technical estimations, proposals, and solution walkthroughs to client/hiring stakeholders. Strong documentation discipline suited to regulated/validated environments. Good analytical and troubleshooting skills for live plant support scenarios.

description:
About the Role We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented Talent Operations Associate to manage and streamline our hiring operations at GoML. You will play a key role in ensuring a smooth candidate experience, managing interview coordination, offer processing, preboarding, candidate engagement, and onboarding readiness. You will also act as a bridge between the Talent Acquisition and HRBP teams, ensuring seamless coordination and a positive transition from candidate to employee. What Youll Do First 30 Days - Learn Support Understand GoMLs hiring process, talent operations workflows, and internal stakeholders. Get familiar with Keka ATS, HRMS, interview tools, and recruitment trackers. Coordinate interviews, panel availability, candidate communication, and scheduling. Ensure interview feedback is collected on time and updated in the ATS. Support offer letter processing, approvals, and candidate documentation. Initiate preboarding activities and track document submissions. Connect regularly with offered candidates to keep them engaged until joining. Understand the onboarding handover process between Talent Acquisition and HRBP. First 60 Days - Own Execute Independently manage end-to-end interview scheduling and recruitment coordination. Own offer processing, approval follow-ups, offer acceptance tracking, and joining confirmations. Manage the complete preboarding process, including documentation, background verification coordination, and joining formalities. Drive preboarding candidate engagement through regular check-ins, welcome communications, joining updates, and query resolution. Track candidates serving notice periods, identify potential dropouts, and proactively flag joining risks. Coordinate with HRBP, IT, and hiring managers to ensure everything is ready before Day 1. Maintain accurate candidate data, recruitment trackers, offer records, and upcoming-joiner dashboards. Support campus hiring drives, internship onboarding, and recruitment events. Coordinate recruitment vendor invoices, employee referrals, and related operational activities. First 90 Days - Improve Optimize Take complete ownership of day-to-day talent operations with minimal supervision. Establish structured preboarding engagement touchpoints to improve candidate experience and joining conversion. Ensure seamless handovers between Talent Acquisition and HRBP, with clear documentation and ownership. Standardize interview coordination, offer processing, preboarding, and onboarding checklists. Track key operational metrics, including interview turnaround time, offer processing time, offer acceptance, and joining conversion. Identify operational bottlenecks and improve workflows through process enhancements and automation. Maintain ATS/HRMS data accuracy and ensure timely operational reporting. Gather candidate and new-joiner feedback to improve the overall hiring and onboarding experience. Build scalable talent operations processes to support GoMLs growing hiring needs. What Were Looking For 1-2 years of experience in Talent Operations, Recruitment Coordination, or HR Operations. Good understanding of recruitment processes, offer management, preboarding, and onboarding. Hands-on experience with ATS/HRMS platforms; experience with Keka is a plus. Strong communication, coordination, and stakeholder management skills. Ability to manage multiple tasks, prioritize effectively, and follow up proactively. Good working knowledge of Excel, Google Sheets, and recruitment reporting. Strong attention to detail, documentation, and data accuracy. Ability to handle confidential candidate and employee information responsibly. A process-oriented mindset with strong ownership and problem-solving skills. Experience in a startup or fast-paced technology environment is an advantage. What Success Looks Like Interviews, offers, and preboarding activities are completed on time. Offered candidates remain engaged and informed throughout their notice period. Candidate dropouts and last-minute joining challenges are proactively managed. Every new joiner experiences a smooth, organized, and welcoming transition. Talent Acquisition and HRBP have clear visibility into upcoming joiners and handover activities. Recruitment records, trackers, and operational dashboards are accurate and up to date. Talent operations run efficiently through clear processes, ownership, and continuous improvement. Why Join GoML At GoML, youll be part of a growing team building impactful AI solutions. Youll have the opportunity to take ownership, improve how we hire and onboard talent, and help create a seamless experience for every new team member. If you enjoy working with people, bringing structure to processes, and making things happen, wed love to hear from you!

title: L3 Observability
description:
Job Description for L3 Managed Service Engineer - Observability 
 Role Summary 
Level 3 Managed Service Engineer serves as the senior escalation point and technical authority for end-to-end observability across the environment. This role is responsible for resolving or driving resolution of highly complex incidents spanning application, infrastructure, network, and third-party dependencies, while owning observability strategy, Datadog architecture, monitoring standards, and continuous improvement. The engineer is expected to guide L1 and L2 engineers, lead root cause analysis and major incident reviews, and partner with cross-functional teams to improve detection, reduce noise, and strengthen operational resilience for both 3-tier and cloud-native applications.
 Key Responsibilities 
 Serve as the final escalation and technical authority for complex, cross-domain incidents involving application, infrastructure, network, and third-party dependencies. Own the end-to-end observability architecture and strategy in Datadog, including instrumentation standards, tagging strategy, dashboard governance, and monitor design principles. Lead root cause analysis for major/critical incidents and drive post-incident reviews, ensuring permanent fixes and preventive monitoring are implemented. Define and continuously improve monitoring coverage for new and existing services, including 3-tier applications, microservices, and cloud-native workloads. Design and govern SLOs/SLIs aligned to business-critical services, and advise application and platform teams on instrumentation best practices. Drive automation initiatives: Datadog-as-code (Terraform/API-based configuration management), auto-remediation workflows, and integration with CI/CD pipelines. Partner with application, infrastructure, network, and security teams to close monitoring gaps and reduce mean time to detect (MTTD) and mean time to resolve (MTTR). Own capacity planning and performance engineering insights derived from long-term observability data trends. Manage Datadog platform health: cost optimization, license/usage governance, data retention, and integration management. Mentor L1 and L2 engineers, review their RCA quality, and build enablement material (runbooks, training, best practices). Act as a key stakeholder in client governance calls, presenting trends, risks, and improvement roadmaps. Evaluate and pilot new Datadog features or complementary observability tools, and lead their rollout. Define escalation matrices and coordinate cross-team response during major outages. Required Skills and Experience 
 6+ years of experience in Managed Services, SRE, or platform engineering roles, with at least 3 years of hands-on ownership of a Datadog (or equivalent) observability platform at scale. Expert-level knowledge of Datadog, including: Platform architecture: organization/team structuring, RBAC, tagging strategy, and multi-environment setups. APM: distributed tracing at scale, service dependency mapping, and instrumentation strategy across polyglot environments. Synthetics and RUM: designing comprehensive digital experience monitoring strategies tied to business KPIs. Log Management: pipeline architecture, log-based metrics, and cost/volume governance. SLOs, error budgets, and anomaly/forecast-based alerting at an advanced level. Deep understanding of infrastructure and cloud architecture: compute, containers, orchestration (Kubernetes), auto-scaling, and multi-cloud/hybrid environments. Deep understanding of networking: routing, load balancing, CDN, DNS, and complex connectivity troubleshooting across hybrid environments. Strong incident and problem management leadership experience, including major incident command and post-incident review facilitation. Experience defining and governing observability standards across multiple teams or business units. Application & Architecture Understanding (technology-agnostic) 
 Expert-level understanding of 3-tier and N-tier application architectures, including how failures cascade across presentation, application, and data layers. Expert-level understanding of cloud-native and distributed architectures: microservices, event-driven systems, service meshes, API gateways, and asynchronous messaging. Ability to advise application teams on observability best practices (instrumentation, tracing context propagation, structured logging) without needing to write code in a specific language. Strong grasp of resiliency and failure patterns (retries, circuit breakers, backpressure, caching, graceful degradation) and how to detect their failure modes through observability data. Good to Have 
 Datadog advanced/expert certifications, or equivalent recognized observability certifications. Strong scripting/automation background (Python, Terraform, or similar) for Datadog-as-code and custom tooling. Experience with FinOps or cost governance for observability tooling at scale. Exposure to multiple observability ecosystems (New Relic, Dynatrace, Splunk, Grafana/Prometheus, OpenTelemetry). Experience presenting to senior stakeholders or clients on observability maturity and roadmaps. Soft Skills 
 Strategic thinking with the ability to balance immediate incident needs against long-term platform health. Strong leadership and mentoring capability across L1/L2 engineers. Excellent stakeholder management and executive communication skills. Calm, decisive leadership during major incidents. Strong documentation and process-governance discipline. Education 
 Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience). Work Details 
 Level: L3 (Senior/Lead, Managed Services) Shift: Primarily general shift, with on-call responsibility for major incident escalations Reporting To: Observability Practice Lead / Delivery Manager

title: Team Member - Stores & Logistics
description:
Job Purpose 
 The Stores Logistics Engineer is responsible for managing the receipt, storage, inventory control, handling, and dispatch of raw materials, purchased components, consumables, sub-assemblies, and finished CNC machines. The role ensures uninterrupted material availability for production, accurate inventory records, efficient warehouse operations, and timely logistics coordination to support manufacturing and customer delivery commitments. 
 
 Key Roles Responsibilities 
 
 1. Store Management 
 Manage inward receipt of raw materials, bought-out parts, electrical components, consumables, and production materials. Verify incoming materials against purchase orders, delivery challans, and quality requirements. Ensure proper storage, identification, labeling, and preservation of materials. Maintain organized warehouse layouts for efficient material movement and retrieval. Implement FIFO (First-In-First-Out) and inventory control practices. Monitor stock levels and initiate replenishment requests to avoid shortages. 
 
 2. Inventory Control 
 Maintain accurate inventory records in ERP/MRP systems. Perform regular stock verification, cycle counts, and annual physical inventory audits. Investigate inventory discrepancies and implement corrective actions. Track slow-moving, non-moving, and obsolete inventory. Generate inventory reports and KPIs for management review. Ensure optimum inventory levels while minimizing carrying costs. 
 
 3. Production Material Coordination 
 Issue materials to production as per work orders and production schedules. Coordinate with Production, Planning, Procurement, and Quality teams to ensure timely material availability. Monitor material consumption and report variances. Support production continuity by ensuring adequate stock of critical machine components. 
 
 4. Logistics Transportation Management 
 Coordinate inbound and outbound logistics activities. Arrange transportation for dispatch of CNC machines, spare parts, and customer orders. Liaise with transporters, freight forwarders, and logistics service providers. Ensure timely shipment scheduling and delivery tracking. Optimize transportation costs and improve logistics efficiency. Manage export and domestic shipment documentation when applicable. 
 
 5. Documentation Compliance 
 Maintain all stores and logistics records accurately. Prepare GRN (Goods Receipt Notes), Material Issue Notes, Delivery Challans, and Dispatch Documents. Ensure compliance with company procedures, inventory standards, and safety regulations. Support internal and external audits by maintaining proper documentation. Ensure adherence to statutory and transportation compliance requirements. 
 
 6. Warehouse Operations Safety 
 Ensure safe handling of machine components, heavy parts, and finished goods. Maintain warehouse cleanliness, housekeeping, and 5S standards. Monitor material handling equipment utilization and maintenance. Implement safety practices related to storage, loading, unloading, and transportation. Identify and drive continuous improvement initiatives in stores and logistics processes. 
 
 7. Vendor and Stakeholder Coordination 
 Coordinate with suppliers regarding material deliveries and shortages. Work closely with procurement teams to resolve supply issues. Support customer dispatch requirements and delivery commitments. Communicate effectively with cross-functional teams regarding inventory status and logistics schedules.

 Organisation Chart:

 Job Purpose The Mechanical Maintenance Incharge is responsible for leading and managing the mechanical maintenance function at Unit-IV, Karumathampatti, Coimbatore. The role ensures maximum equipment availability, reliability, and performance through effective people management, manufacturing improvements, system implementation, cost effectiveness, and a relentless focus on achieving zero accidents. The incumbent will drive preventive, predictive, and breakdown maintenance strategies while fostering a culture of continuous improvement, safety, and operational excellence. 
 Key Responsibilities People Management 
 Lead, mentor, and develop the mechanical maintenance team, including Shift Supervisors and Helpers. Allocate manpower effectively across shifts to ensure uninterrupted maintenance coverage. Conduct regular training needs analysis and skill development programs for team members. Foster a positive work culture, discipline, and high morale within the maintenance function. Set clear performance expectations, conduct periodic reviews, and provide constructive feedback. 
 Manufacturing Improvements 
 Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance equipment reliability, availability, and overall plant efficiency. Analyse recurring breakdowns and implement root cause corrective and preventive actions (RCCPA). Optimise maintenance schedules, spares consumption, and repair methodologies to reduce downtime. Collaborate with production and quality teams to improve Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE). Implement reliability-centred maintenance (RCM) and total productive maintenance (TPM) practices. 
 System Implementation 
 Establish and maintain robust maintenance management systems, including CMMS (Computerised Maintenance Management System). Ensure adherence to standard operating procedures (SOPs), work instructions, and maintenance checklists. Maintain accurate records of maintenance activities, equipment history, and spares inventory. Implement and sustain 5S, Kaizen, and other lean manufacturing systems within the maintenance function. Ensure compliance with statutory, environmental, and safety management systems. 
 Cost Effectiveness 
 Prepare and manage the mechanical maintenance budget, ensuring optimal utilisation of resources. Control spares and consumables inventory to minimise carrying costs while ensuring availability. Identify and implement cost-reduction opportunities without compromising equipment reliability or safety. Evaluate vendor performance and negotiate contracts for external maintenance services. Monitor and report key maintenance KPIs, including MTBF, MTTR, and maintenance cost per tonne. 
 Zero Accident 
 Champion a strong safety culture with the goal of zero accidents and zero harm. Ensure strict adherence to safety protocols, permit-to-work systems, and lockout/tagout procedures. Conduct regular safety audits, risk assessments, and toolbox talks for the maintenance team. Investigate and report all incidents, near misses, and unsafe conditions, implementing corrective actions. Ensure all maintenance activities comply with applicable safety regulations and company policies. 
 (E) Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Equipment Availability and Reliability (MTBF, MTTR) Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE) improvement Reduction in Breakdown Frequency and Downtime Maintenance Cost per Unit of Production Spares Inventory Turnover and Cost Control Adherence to Preventive Maintenance Schedule Safety Incident Rate (Target: Zero Accidents) Team Productivity and Skill Development Metrics CMMS Data Accuracy and Compliance Implementation of Continuous Improvement Projects 
 Qualifications and Experience Criteria Requirement Educational Qualification Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering (B.E. / B.Tech) or equivalent 
 Total Experience 18-25+ years of relevant experience in mechanical maintenance 
 Industry Experience Automobile or Engineering Industry preferred 
 Functional Experience Hands-on experience in preventive, predictive, and breakdown maintenance of heavy machinery and equipment 
 Leadership Experience Proven track record of leading maintenance teams in a manufacturing environment Technical Expertise Strong knowledge of hydraulics, pneumatics, rotating equipment, conveyors, crushers, mixers, and utility systems Systems Knowledge Proficiency in CMMS, TPM, RCM, 5S, Kaizen, and lean maintenance practices Safety Knowledge Thorough understanding of industrial safety standards, permit-to-work systems, and statutory compliance 
 (G) Competencies Behavioural Competencies: Leadership and People Management Decision Making and Problem Solving Communication and Interpersonal Skills Ownership and Accountability Safety Orientation Cost Consciousness Change Management Technical Competencies: Mechanical Maintenance Management Reliability Engineering Root Cause Analysis (RCA) CMMS and Maintenance Planning Spare Parts Management Budgeting and Cost Control Safety and Statutory Compliance (H) Working Conditions Work Environment: Manufacturing plant environment with exposure to heavy machinery, noise, heat, and dust. Work Schedule: General shift with flexibility to work extended hours, shifts, or weekends as required to meet maintenance and production needs. Travel: Minimal; occasional travel for vendor visits or training may be required. Physical Requirements: Ability to walk through the plant, climb ladders, and inspect equipment as needed. title: Engineer , Sr Engineer - Test  ATE RF
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION RF ATE TEST ENGINEER Department: Test Development Services (TDS)
 Function: Semiconductor Test Development / IC Testing
 Location: Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India
 Experience: 3–14 Years
 Position Code: RF_01 : RF ATE Test Engineer (3-5 Years exp. ) Position Code: RF_02 : Sr RF ATE Test Engineer (5-14 years)
 Employment Type: Full-Time 1. Job Purpose To develop, debug, characterize, and optimize Automated Test Equipment (ATE) test solutions for RF, Analog, and Mixed-Signal semiconductor devices. The role will support the complete product lifecycle, from first-silicon bring-up and characterization to production test release, yield improvement, and high-volume manufacturing. 2. Key Responsibilities A. ATE Test Development Develop, debug, and optimize production test programs for RF, Analog, and Mixed-Signal ICs. Design and implement test solutions using Advantest V93K (SmarTest 8 preferred) or Teradyne UltraFLEX/J750 platforms. Develop and maintain test methodologies to ensure accurate, repeatable, and reliable device measurements. Support test program optimization, test coverage improvement, and production test-time reduction. B. Product Characterization and Validation Support first-silicon bring-up, device characterization, production test development, qualification, and production release. Execute characterization across Process, Voltage, and Temperature (PVT) conditions. Develop and characterize RF, Analog, and Mixed-Signal circuit blocks, including: Phase-Locked Loops (PLLs) Analog-to-Digital Converters (ADCs) Digital-to-Analog Converters (DACs) Oscillators and timing devices Power management circuits RF transceivers and related IPs Correlate ATE measurements with laboratory bench measurements and validation results. C. RF Measurement and Data Analysis Perform RF characterization and testing involving frequency, output power, phase noise, harmonics, linearity, and sensitivity, as applicable to the device under test. Analyze characterization data and identify performance trends, outliers, and potential failure mechanisms. Use data analysis tools such as Excel, MATLAB, Python, or JMP to support engineering decisions. D. Debugging and Yield Improvement Investigate test failures, perform root-cause analysis, and implement corrective and preventive actions. Drive yield improvement, test coverage enhancement, and product quality initiatives. Identify opportunities to optimize test time and reduce manufacturing costs without compromising quality or reliability. Support production ramp-up and resolve ATE-related issues in high-volume manufacturing environments. E. Cross-Functional Collaboration and Documentation Collaborate with Design, Product Engineering, Validation, Applications, and Manufacturing teams throughout the product development cycle. Prepare test specifications, characterization reports, test documentation, and production release packages. Support product qualification, release readiness, and ongoing manufacturing improvements. 3. Required Qualifications Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Instrumentation Engineering, or a related discipline. 3–7 years of relevant experience in semiconductor ATE test development, preferably involving RF, Analog, or Mixed-Signal products. Hands-on experience with at least one of the following ATE platforms: Advantest V93K – SmarTest 8 preferred Teradyne UltraFLEX / J750 Strong understanding of RF fundamentals, analog and digital electronics, mixed-signal testing, and semiconductor device characterization. Practical experience in RF measurement and characterization techniques. Familiarity with production test development, device characterization, and test program debugging. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills. Effective communication and collaboration skills for working in cross-functional engineering teams. 4. Preferred Skills Experience testing RF ICs, PLLs, oscillators, transceivers, wireless connectivity devices, or timing products. Knowledge of RF bench instruments and measurement techniques, where applicable. Understanding of semiconductor product engineering, manufacturing processes, and production release requirements. Experience in statistical data analysis, yield improvement, and systematic failure analysis. Exposure to test-time optimization, cost reduction, and continuous improvement initiatives. Programming or data analysis experience using Python, MATLAB, Excel, or JMP. 5. Key Competencies ATE Test Program Development and Debugging RF and Mixed-Signal Characterization Semiconductor Test Methodologies Data Analysis and Technical Problem-Solving Root-Cause Analysis and Yield Improvement Test-Time Optimization Cross-Functional Collaboration Documentation and Process Discipline 6. Performance Expectations Success in this role will be demonstrated through: Timely development, debugging, and release of production-ready ATE test programs. Improved test coverage, measurement accuracy, and test repeatability. Effective characterization and correlation of ATE and bench results. Measurable contributions to yield improvement and test-time optimization. Timely resolution of production test issues and adherence to product quality requirements. 7. Candidate Profile The ideal candidate is a hands-on semiconductor test professional with practical ATE programming and debugging experience, a strong foundation in RF and Mixed-Signal electronics, and the ability to support product characterization through production ramp-up. It is an ideal opportunity to build a strong IT foundation while being guided and mentored by an experienced senior team.

This role covers end-user support, asset management, system upkeep, and vendor coordination, making it a well-rounded position for someone looking to grow within an IT support function. 
 Key Responsibilities: Provide day-to-day support to employees on tickets, laptops, logins, printers, software installations, and related requests. Test and deploy Windows and third-party patches through the endpoint management console, monitor patch non-compliance reports, and resolve the root cause of failures. Maintain endpoint security compliance: monitor antivirus and endpoint protection consoles, bring non-compliant systems back into compliance, respond to threat and data-loss-prevention alerts, and validate licence terms for software approval requests. Run scheduled backups of servers, Active Directory, and databases to the NAS, and perform periodic restore checks with project teams to confirm data integrity. Support network and infrastructure monitoring, including Wi-Fi and LAN authentication, firewall and CCTV checks, and report anomalies to the senior team. As part of Enterprise Technology, you ll be at the forefront of enabling innovative technologies including emerging collaboration tools and world-class technology infrastructure. Our aim is to build an outstanding customer experience with clear investment in innovation, alongside operational excellence that delivers efficient, quality services and solutions. You will work with technologists and business specialists to meet the increasing pace of our business. The On-site Technology Support Senior Specialist provides this support to customers within the country or site by performing the highest level of multiple technology support activities. This professional provides meaningful contributions to team efforts to enhance effectiveness; acts creatively to prioritize tasks; interprets information; and applies technical knowledge to satisfy customer and firm objectives. This professional anticipates technology support issues and creates solutions with appropriate consultation. Your key responsibilities Facilitate and support the deployment of hardware and software to end users (including the installation, configuration and testing of more complex firm hardware). Diverse and inclusive culture: You ll be accepted for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs. title: Electrical Maintenance Technician
description:
We are looking for a skilled and certified Electrical Maintenance Technician with a valid C-Licence to join our Engineering team. The role is responsible for the safe and reliable operation, preventive maintenance, breakdown maintenance, and troubleshooting of plant electrical systems, covering equipment from HT yards to production machinery . The position will also play a key role in ensuring statutory compliance, electrical safety, and adherence to applicable state electrical regulations , including validation and certification of electrical installations and modifications. Key Responsibilities 1. Electrical Operations & Maintenance Execute preventive, predictive, and breakdown maintenance of electrical equipment, including: Transformers HT/LT panels MCC/PCC panels VCB/ACB circuit breakers Motors and associated control systems Diagnose and resolve complex electrical faults in: Motors Variable Frequency Drives (VFDs) Programmable Logic Controllers (PLCs) Control circuits and instrumentation interfaces Read and interpret electrical schematics, Single Line Diagrams (SLDs), wiring diagrams, and engineering drawings for troubleshooting and installation activities. Monitor and ensure reliable operation of utility equipment such as Diesel Generator (DG) sets, air compressors, and associated electrical systems . Monitor plant power quality and maintain Power Factor (PF) close to unity through effective operation and maintenance of APFC panels. Coordinate with production and other engineering functions to minimize electrical downtime and ensure uninterrupted plant operations. 2. Statutory Compliance & Licensing Act as the designated C-Licence holder and undertake responsibilities related to electrical installations and modifications within the scope permitted under applicable regulations. Ensure electrical maintenance and installation activities comply with applicable state electricity regulations, electrical safety standards, and statutory requirements . Coordinate with the State Electricity Board and Electrical Inspectorate for inspections, audits, load sanctions, approvals, and licence-related requirements. Maintain statutory records and documentation, including: Electrical inspection records Earth-pit testing records Statutory registers Relevant Form F/H submissions Electrical equipment testing and certification records Ensure timely renewal and maintenance of applicable electrical licences, certificates, and statutory approvals. 3. Electrical Safety Implement and strictly enforce Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) procedures during electrical maintenance activities. Ensure compliance with Permit-to-Work (PTW) systems for electrical work. Conduct regular inspections of electrical installations, panels, cable systems, earthing systems, and electrical rooms to identify potential safety hazards. Ensure appropriate PPE and safe working practices are followed during electrical maintenance and troubleshooting. Support electrical safety audits, risk assessments, and corrective action implementation. 4. Reliability & Continuous Improvement Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for recurring electrical failures and implement corrective and preventive actions. Identify opportunities to improve equipment reliability, reduce breakdowns, and minimize electrical-related production downtime. Monitor maintenance performance indicators such as MTBF, MTTR, breakdown frequency, and maintenance compliance . Maintain proper maintenance records and ensure timely closure of maintenance activities. Drive 5S and good housekeeping practices in electrical rooms, workshops, and plant utility areas. Participate in energy conservation and electrical efficiency improvement initiatives. Required Skills & Competencies Strong knowledge of HT/LT electrical systems and industrial electrical maintenance . Hands-on experience with transformers, HT/LT panels, MCC/PCC, VCB/ACB, motors, VFDs, and control circuits. Knowledge of PLC-based control systems and industrial automation. Ability to read and interpret SLDs, electrical drawings, and wiring diagrams . Good understanding of electrical safety, LOTO, PTW, earthing, and statutory compliance . Knowledge of DG sets, compressors, APFC panels, and plant utilities. Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills. Ability to work effectively in a manufacturing/plant environment. Good coordination and communication skills. Educational Qualification Diploma / ITI in Electrical Engineering / Electrical & Electronics Engineering or equivalent. A valid and relevant C-Licence is mandatory . Additional electrical safety certifications will be an advantage. Experience 5 to 10 years of relevant experience in industrial/manufacturing electrical maintenance . Candidates with hands-on experience in HT/LT systems, plant maintenance, electrical statutory compliance, and troubleshooting will be preferred. Key Performance Areas (KPIs) Electrical equipment availability and reliability Reduction in electrical breakdowns and downtime Preventive maintenance compliance Improvement in MTBF and reduction in MTTR Power Factor and energy efficiency Statutory compliance and timely documentation Electrical safety and LOTO/PTW compliance 5S and housekeeping standards Timely completion of corrective and preventive maintenance activities

title: Network Operations Engineer
description:
Role & responsibilities We are seeking a highly skilled DDI Network Operations Engineer to manage, maintain, and support enterprise DNS, DHCP, IP Address Management (IPAM), Domain Management, and Certificate Management services across a global environment. The role will be responsible for ensuring the availability, security, performance, and operational excellence of DDI platforms, including Infoblox, UltraDNS, CSC, and associated infrastructure. The engineer will support BAU operations, incident resolution, service requests, platform migrations, and continuous service improvements within a 24x7 operational environment. Key Responsibilities DNS Operations Manage and administer Internal DNS services hosted on Infoblox. Support External/Public DNS services through UltraDNS. Implement and maintain DNS records, zones, forwarding, delegation, and split-DNS architectures. Troubleshoot DNS resolution, latency, and availability issues. Support DNS security controls, including DNS Firewall, malicious domain detection, and threat monitoring. Perform DNS-related changes through approved change management processes. DHCP Operations Administer global DHCP services using Infoblox. Manage DHCP scopes, failover associations, reservations, and lease management. Support DHCP migrations and helper-address modifications. Ensure high availability and redundancy of DHCP infrastructure. Troubleshoot DHCP allocation and connectivity issues. IPAM Operations Manage enterprise IP address allocation and subnet planning. Maintain IPAM as the source of truth for network addressing. Support network segmentation requirements for corporate, guest, vendor, voice, and management networks. Perform IP conflict resolution and capacity management. Assist with cloud network integration and AWS-hosted Infoblox migrations. Domain & Certificate Management Manage domain registrations, renewals, and ownership records through CSC. Support SSL/TLS certificate lifecycle activities including issuance, renewal, and replacement. Monitor certificate expiration and ensure compliance with organizational standards. Coordinate with application and infrastructure teams for certificate deployments. Operations & Service Management Monitor operational dashboards and alerts. Review incidents, requests, change records, and service tasks daily. Resolve tickets within SLA commitments. Participate in shift handovers and operational reviews. Support Incident, Request, Problem, and Change Management processes through ServiceNow. Participate in major incident bridges and restoration activities for critical outages. Security & Compliance Support DNS security monitoring and threat visibility initiatives. Ensure logs are forwarded to enterprise SIEM platforms. Adhere to access management, PAM, MFA, and Zero Trust security controls. Maintain compliance with organizational governance and operational standards. Required Technical Skills Strong experience with Infoblox DNS, DHCP, and IPAM administration. Hands-on experience with UltraDNS or Public DNS Experience with CSC Domain Manager and Certificate Manager. Knowledge of DNS architecture, split-DNS, DNS forwarding, delegation, and DNS security. Understanding of DHCP failover and high-availability designs. Experience with ServiceNow ITSM processes. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Network Engineering, or related field. 8+ years of experience in DDI Administration. Experience supporting global enterprise infrastructure environments. Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills. Excellent communication and stakeholder management capabilities. Preferred Certifications Infoblox Certified Professional (ICP) CCNA / CCNP AWS Certified Solutions Architect or AWS Networking Specialty Microsoft Azure Administrator ITIL Foundation Certification Key Tools & Platforms Infoblox Grid Manager UltraDNS CSC Domain Manager CSC Certificate Manager ServiceNow Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD) Soft Skills Customer-focused mindset. Excellent Communication skills Strong incident management and problem-solving abilities. Ability to work in a global 24x7 support model. Excellent documentation and process adherence. Effective collaboration with network, security, cloud, and infrastructure teams. Experience Level Senior Network Operations Engineer (DDI) | 5-8+ Years Experience

description:
Position Overview We are looking for an experienced Stores Manager with approximately 10+ years of experience in manufacturing stores and warehouse operations , preferably from the valve, Oil & Gas, engineering or industrial manufacturing industry . 
 The candidate should have strong hands-on experience in ERP-based stores management, inventory control, material traceability, warehouse systems, inward/outward material control and coordination with Purchase, Production, Planning, Quality and Finance .

 The ideal candidate should be systems-oriented, ERP proficient and data-driven , with the ability to establish strong inventory controls and ensure accurate real-time stock information. 
 Stores & Warehouse Management Manage the complete stores and warehouse operations for raw materials, bought-out components, consumables, WIP and finished goods. Establish and maintain systematic storage, identification and retrieval of materials. Ensure proper material segregation and storage based on material type, status and usage. Take ownership of ERP-based stores and inventory transactions . Ensure all material movements are accurately recorded in the ERP system. Ensure real-time inventory visibility through the ERP system. Identify and eliminate gaps between physical stock and ERP stock . Establish controls for minimum/maximum stock levels and reorder requirements. Ensure proper identification and traceability of: Heat numbers Material codes Batch numbers Lot numbers Purchase orders MTCs Inspection status Material status Job/work-order references Plan and conduct periodic physical stock verification . Implement cycle-counting systems for critical and high-value materials. Reconcile physical inventory with ERP records. Investigate and close inventory variances. Support internal, customer and external audits. Maintain proper documentation for stock verification and reconciliation. Maintain accurate records for: GRNs Material issue slips Material return notes Stock transfer documents Inspection status Rejection/quarantine records Scrap records Inventory reconciliation Cycle-count records Material traceability records Dispatch documentation Approximately 10+ years of experience in Stores / Warehouse / Inventory Management . Strong experience in a manufacturing environment . Experience managing a stores team and multiple warehouse activities. Proven experience in ERP-based inventory management . Strong understanding of material traceability and inventory controls. Experience handling high-value engineering/manufacturing materials. Education Degree/Diploma in Mechanical Engineering, Production, Supply Chain, Logistics, Materials Management or related discipline.
